verdict.rationale: Greenhouse is a SaaS recruiting platform, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no mention of telemetry controls, analytics opt-out, or tracking preferences. The audit log and the data-silo claims for the AI notetaker are different features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
